sectors.trend: Mixed. Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test (positive for FMG.AX/BHP.AX supply chain), Dalaroo 12,000m African gold drilling and Lindian 20-yr Kazakhstan rare earths offtake signal exploration momentum. However, Bathla collapse raises structural concerns.
sectors.implications: Small/mid-cap miners (Dalaroo, Critical Resources) see optionality; majors (BHP.AX, FMG.AX, RIO.AX) supported by iron ore test but face demand uncertainty from slowing Chinese property. Rare earths (Lindian) benefit from supply-chain diversification.

sectors.trend: Negative. CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price declines. CBA/Westpac pricing loopholes draw consumer backlash. Goldman Sachs highlights dividend financials as attractive.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM pressure from rate hike cycle but benefit from higher yields. Dividend income strategy favoured. Housing correction risks credit losses.

sectors.trend: Positive for gas. TMK Energy rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns. However, energy transition costs 'running off rails' and data centre power demand faces community opposition.
sectors.implications: SGL.AX, BOQ.AX, WDS.AX benefit from gas price strength. Data centre power demand (WES.AX, AGL.AX) is a long-term tailwind but near-term NIMT risk. Oil falls on Dow futures offset by Persian Gulf tanker risk.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging. Victorian healthcare system 'fundamentally broken' per GP. CSL.AX (CSL.AX) relatively insulated.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. GLP-1 tablet shift may pressure biotech peers but benefits pharma diversification. Public health strain supports private healthcare (IAG.AX, HIC.AX).

sectors.trend: Positive globally (Nvidia $18b deal, AI boom 'not over'), but Australian data centre boom faces community backlash and energy constraints.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited; benefits flow to power/infrastructure (WES.AX, SSO.AX). Nvidia strength supports global risk appetite lifting ^AXJO.

sectors.trend: Negative. 10% house price fall forecast; Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with population growth. Home loan demand collapsing.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Construction (WBC.AX, WES.AX) may see delayed pipeline. Consumer credit stress rising.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight financials for yield; underweight property REITs; monitor CPI and loan data weekly
Hedge with gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX); reduce energy exposure; maintain cash buffer
Monitor KPG.AX; assess contagion to other Big Four-linked entities; avoid until clarity
Hedge import-heavy miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX); favour domestic-revenue names
Maintain liquidity; avoid leveraged small-caps; stress-test portfolios

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gas and energy producers on TMK rate surge and Mongolian drilling catalyst
opportunities.rationale: Gas price strength supports margins; Beetaloo cartel dynamics favour integrated players

opportunities.recommendation: Add rare earths and gold exploration names on supply-chain diversification theme
opportunities.rationale: Lindian 20-yr offtake and Dalaroo drilling signal capital deployment; geopolitical premium on gold

opportunities.recommendation: Position in dividend-paying financials for income amid rate cycle
opportunities.rationale: Goldman Sachs flags 4 dividend financials; higher rates support NIM despite loan softness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and construction exposure ahead of 10% house price correction
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecast; 15% loan application drop signals demand collapse

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge geopolitical risk with gold and cash; avoid leveraged positions
defensive_moves.rationale: Persian Gulf tanker attacks and Iran conflict reignite; crypto/silver already falling

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid KPMG-linked exposure until ASIC probe concludes
defensive_moves.rationale: Regulatory overhang and political pressure create binary downside risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open higher on Wall Street/Nvidia strength but face headwinds from RBA rate hike fears, housing data, and geopolitical volatility. Expect choppy, range-bound trading. ^AXJO may test resistance on tech lift but financials drag on housing concerns.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural concerns (Bathla/Ponzi economy, housing correction, energy transition costs) cap upside. Mining and energy offer cyclical support. Healthcare (CSL.AX) and dividend financials provide defensive ballast. 6-12 month path depends on RBA pivot timing and global growth.
